name: presensi-mk-statistika-ti25c
description: Sistem Presensi Mahasiswa Kelas TI25C - Statistika

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('client/dist/index.html')) { console.log('Client bundle verified in client/dist'); } else { console.log('Building from source...'); require('child_process').execSync('cd client && npm install && npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
